description.value: GPS setup: Add only learned Arrow marker items. On-hit options are offered after a successful shortbow/longbow attack made with the Attack action. Use Seeking or Piercing Arrow directly from this item instead of rolling a normal attack; these add the selected bow damage and use a Dexterity save for half. Confirm line/path and recent-sighting requirements manually. Only one option may be used per turn. Weapon item macros and attack-only riders are not triggered by substituted saves.
